system.description:
Fortitude Amp

You have been blessed by the Basilisk, your clans divine figure, gaining the following benefits;

Basilisk Blood. At the beginning of each of your turns, you regain 1 Viper Blood and Hebi Clan features and effects that cost 2 or more Viper Blood, cost one less.

Basilisk’s Health. When you regain hit points as a result of the Serpent Blood clan feature, you instead regain hit points equal to your level and When you spend Viper Blood to attempt to remove ranks of a Physical or Elemental conditions through the Venomous Technique clan feature, you make that saving throw at advantage.

Basilisk’s Coil. Once per turn, it costs 0 Viper Blood to use a Strike ability as part of a Hebi Clan Hijutsu you cast.
system.summary: Regain 1 Viper Blood a turn and pay 1 less on big costs. Better Serpent Blood healing, and free Strikes on Hebi Hijutsu.

rules.text: Start: Bonus action and 4 Viper Blood. Ends if you're incapacitated, or dismiss it on your turn.
